evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Support user acceptance testing, production releases, enhancement requests and post-implementation issue resolution.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour signals (UAT, controlled production releases, security measures, reporting governance, performance monitoring) dominate throughout with no velocity/shipping-speed language present anywhere in the JD.
evidence.domain_risk: Our client, a large organisation operating within the financial services sector, is seeking an experienced BI Engineer
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The hiring organisation is explicitly named as operating within financial services in the very first line of the job description, and 'previous experience within financial services or another highly regulated environment' appears as a desirable skill, placing this at high.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Manage reporting assets within Microsoft Fabric and Power BI Service, including workspaces, applications, refresh schedules, access controls and deployment processes.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Named tools and governance practices (Microsoft Fabric, Power BI Service, workspaces, deployment processes, security) appear directly in responsibilities, indicating an established, growing BI practice rather than a from-scratch build.
evidence.jd_authorship: Create efficient and maintainable DAX calculations while applying appropriate performance and error-handling practices.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name precise tools and technical actions (DAX, Power Query, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI Service workspaces, row-level security), letting the reader understand the actual day-to-day work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Convert business needs, reporting specifications and metric definitions into effective visualisations, measures, filters and drill-through functionality.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role serves general internal business reporting needs and the BI/semantic layer itself rather than a single named commercial, product, or finance function, so internal_data.
evidence.autonomy_level: Convert business needs, reporting specifications and metric definitions into effective visualisations... Experience translating business requirements into accurate, user-friendly and maintainable reporting solutions.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role receives and translates business requirements into deliverables (dashboards, models) rather than setting direction or strategy, matching execution.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No mention anywhere of AI tools for the candidate's own work or AI systems consuming the candidate's data output.
evidence.testing_framing: Support user acceptance testing, production releases, enhancement requests and post-implementation issue resolution.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: UAT and production release support appear as a listed responsibility without explicit ownership/definition framing of a testing standard, matching tool_listed.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Implement suitable security measures, including workspace permissions, audience access and row-level security.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Security, row-level access control, and reporting governance are named responsibilities, and the employer's own financial-services sector adds regulatory weight, but the JD's dominant framing remains dashboard delivery rather than an explicit compliance/audit register, keeping this moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Design, build and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions aligned with agreed business requirements.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role maintains, monitors, and improves existing BI assets and governance practices (performance tuning, access control, BAU support) more than it builds new infrastructure from scratch, indicating fix/scale work.
evidence.work_arrangement: Westmeath-based role with office attendance required 4 days per week.
evidence.loss_aversion: "Implement suitable security measures" and reporting governance are named responsibilities set against a financial-services employer, but the JD's dominant framing remains dashboard delivery rather than an explicit compliance/audit register.
